[[File:HelaBrandes.jpg|thumb|200px|right|Music Advisor [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]]]]
'''Music Advisor''' was the title held by the member of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] in charge of funding and supervision of arts and cultural events on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|helabrandes|Brandes, Hela}}</ref> The associated bureaucracy was known as the '''Office of the Music Advisor'''.<ref name="SWG:AFRNA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Arts Festival Requires Naboo Animals}} on Naboo</ref>

==History==
[[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]] was the Music Advisor around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="DB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Deftoi]] of [[Muntro VI]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], staged an edition of their decennial [[Otherworld Arts Festival]]. The festival included a quasi-operatic performance depicting the events of the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]] of Naboo. For this purpose, the Deftoi requested the Office of the Music Advisor of Naboo to provide carcasses of Naboo animals for the show.<ref name="SWG:AFRNA" />
